title: Animate new transcript messages without changing scroll geometry
outcome: Add a subtle, motion-safe reveal for newly appended transcript content while preserving the single pre-paint scroll authority that keeps LIVE TURN stable. The animation must not affect layout height, scrollTop, virtualization measurement, tail attachment, or first-wheel geometry; respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid replaying on hydration/history adoption.
acceptance: New resident messages may fade/translate visually without changing layout geometry; attached streaming remains frame-stable; detached readers keep their viewport; historical/hydrated messages do not replay entry animation; reduced-motion disables the transition; focused tests and a built UI verify no scroll regressions.
